atom_catalog.declared_scope: Use when an AI or agent product needs architecture, lifecycle, assurance, field-learning, or Rust engineering decisions.
atom_catalog.positive_boundary: Own the topology or control-boundary decision itself.
atom_catalog.admission_rule: Admit only for a direct instance of this controlling decision; topical relevance, downstream usefulness, and possible future need are insufficient.

pairwise_exclusions.boundary: Exclude when task-contract definition is the direct decision and topology is only context.
Exclude when verification strategy is the direct decision and topology is only context.
Exclude when governed learning is the direct decision and topology is only context.
